posts.title: Introductory Webinar - FASD-Informed Care: Striving for Equity

summary_en: A free 60-minute introductory webinar from the Florida Center Training Institute, presented by clinical psychologist Dr. Christie Petrenko. It introduces FASD-informed care: what fetal alcohol spectrum disorders (FASD) are, how a diagnosis helps children and families, and the practical principles of FASD-informed care. Dr. Petrenko also introduces FMF Connect Pro, an app-based tool to support provider competence, and invites professionals to join an upcoming research cohort. Held Tuesday 15 December 2026, 12:00-13:00 Eastern Time (01:00-02:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 16 December), live on Zoom, free of charge, in English, with advance registration required. One free CEU is available for psychologists, social workers, marriage and family therapists and mental health counsellors. Designed for professionals working with children aged 3-13 with FASD or prenatal alcohol exposure.
summary_zh: Florida Center Training Institute 免費 60 分鐘網上講座，由臨床心理學家 Christie Petrenko 博士主講，介紹 FASD 知情照顧：甚麼是胎兒酒精譜系障礙（FASD）、診斷如何幫到孩子與家庭，以及 FASD 知情照顧的實務原則。講者亦介紹 FMF Connect Pro 應用程式（提升專業人員照顧能力的手機工具），並邀請專業人員加入研究團隊。2026 年 12 月 15 日（星期二）美東時間 12:00–13:00 舉行（香港／澳門時間 12 月 16 日星期三凌晨 1:00–2:00），Zoom 線上，費用全免，全程英語，須預先報名。可獲 1 個免費 CEU（心理學家、社工、婚姻家庭治療師、精神健康輔導員）。對象為照顧 3 至 13 歲 FASD 或曾受產前酒精影響兒童的專業人員。
